counterfactual_missing_items: No granulomas or acid-fast bacilli described in bone marrow
No soluble CD25/NK-cell assay or genetic HLH testing
decisive_items: TrueNat MTB/RIF Assay: MTB detected with Rifampicin indeterminate
response.rationale: R7 uniquely integrates the definitive raw molecular MTB detection with bone-marrow hemophagocytosis and hyperferritinemia/cytopenias, covering both the infectious cause and the HLH complication. R5 captures MTB but omits HLH; R4 captures HLH but omits MTB; R6 and R2 rely on nonspecific cytopenias, organomegaly, or lymphadenopathy without malignant or clonal raw evidence.

rejected.why: Leukopenia/thrombocytopenia and marrow erythroid hyperplasia are nonspecific; no blasts, dysplasia, or clonal marker, and MTB/hemophagocytosis better explain the picture.
HLH features are present, but it ignores the positive TrueNat MTB result and therefore lacks the underlying cause.
Hepatosplenomegaly and external iliac lymphadenopathy are nonspecific; no lymph node biopsy or clonal evidence, and MTB/hemophagocytosis are more specific.
